visual.description: Vertical tab layout with 5 fabric cards. Left side: tab list with progress indicator. Tabs: (1) Organic Cotton, (2) Linen, (3) Hemp, (4) Tencel (Lyocell), (5) Merino Wool. Each tab activates in sequence synced to voiceover. Right side: for each active tab, show a glass surface card with fabric properties (antimicrobial, durable, moisture-wicking, etc.). Active tab highlighted in Accent Pink, inactive in Sage. Dot-grid background.

items.title: Hemp
items.description: Most durable natural fiber, softens with washing

notes: Tone shift — from problem to solution. Vertical tabs give each fabric its moment as the voiceover names them. Glass surface cards for the right-side detail panels. Progress bar shows how many fabrics have been covered. Merino (last tab) gets extra time since the voiceover highlights the eczema trial.
